summary: Damage-control laparotomy in a 27-year-old after high-speed MVC with hemorrhagic shock. Splenectomy for a shattered spleen, ~20 cm non-viable small bowel resected and left in discontinuity. Massive transfusion (8 PRBC / 6 FFP / 2 platelets / 1 cryo), EBL >= 3 L, norepinephrine. Damage-control: open abdomen with wound vac, laparotomy pads intentionally retained, counts intentionally incorrect. To ICU intubated on pressors, planned second look in 24-48 h.

key_facts.disposition: ICU intubated on norepinephrine, second look OR in 24-48h

must.counts_not_flagged_as_error: the incorrect count is intentional damage-control, handoff/opnote must say so, not report it as a lost sponge
must.family_tone: serious and honest but not graphic; conveys critical condition, ICU, team is doing everything, surgeon will speak in person

family_update_must: surgery to stop bleeding / remove the spleen
patient is in critical condition / very sick
going to the intensive care unit
surgeon will speak with the family in person
family_update_must_not: the phrase 'incorrect count' without explaining it was intentional
